title: Add comprehensive result page with editing, download, and comparison features

requirements.text: Create a new comprehensive result page route that displays all parsed resume data including contact information, work experience with durations and descriptions, education history, skills categorized by type (technical, soft, domain) with proficiency levels, and certifications

quotes: Display parsed resume data, scoring breakdown, skill matches, and recommendations

acceptanceCriteria: Route is accessible after resume analysis completes
All extracted resume fields are displayed in organized sections
Contact information section shows name, email, phone, and location
Work experience section displays each position with company, title, duration, and description
Education section shows degrees, institutions, and graduation dates
Skills are grouped by category with proficiency badges
Certifications are listed with issuing organization and dates

requirements.text: Display the comprehensive scoring breakdown on the result page showing the overall resume score, completeness score (name, contact, experience, education, skills), content quality score (experience duration, career progression), formatting score, and skill relevance score with detailed feedback for each dimension
acceptanceCriteria: Overall score is prominently displayed with a progress indicator or chart
Each scoring dimension (completeness, content quality, formatting, skill relevance) shows its individual score
Visual indicators (progress bars, color coding) distinguish score levels
Detailed feedback text explains strengths and areas for improvement in each dimension

requirements.text: Show skill matches and gaps on the result page by comparing resume skills against the selected job role requirements, highlighting matching skills with green styling and missing or insufficient proficiency skills with red/yellow styling, categorized by technical and soft skills
acceptanceCriteria: Matching skills are displayed with green indicators
Missing skills are highlighted in red
Skills with insufficient proficiency are shown in yellow/orange
Skills are grouped into technical and soft skill categories
Each skill shows the required vs. current proficiency level

requirements.text: Display actionable recommendations on the result page including personalized learning resources (courses from Udemy, Coursera, freeCodeCamp) and practice projects for each skill gap identified in the analysis
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendations section is clearly visible on the result page
Each missing skill has associated course recommendations with external links
Practice projects are suggested for hands-on skill development
Recommendations are personalized based on the specific skill gaps identified

requirements.text: Implement inline editing functionality on the result page allowing users to modify extracted resume data fields (contact info, work experience, education, skills) with save functionality that updates the backend resume record

quotes: Allow editing of extracted data inline

acceptanceCriteria: Each editable field has an edit button or inline edit capability
Users can modify text fields, dates, and skill proficiency levels
Changes are validated before saving
Save button persists changes to the backend
Success/error feedback is shown after save attempts
The page reflects updated data immediately after successful save

requirements.text: Add a download report button on the result page that generates and downloads a comprehensive PDF report containing the resume analysis including job role match percentage, matching and missing skills, personalized recommendations, and candidate profile data (experience, education, certifications)
acceptanceCriteria: Download button is prominently displayed on the result page
Clicking the button generates a PDF report
PDF includes all key analysis data: scores, skills, gaps, recommendations
PDF is formatted professionally with clear sections
Download initiates automatically after generation
Loading indicator shows during PDF generation

requirements.text: Implement a compare feature on the result page that allows users to select and analyze multiple resumes side-by-side, displaying comparative metrics such as overall scores, skill overlap, experience levels, and education backgrounds for all selected candidates

quotes: Include compare feature to analyze multiple resumes side-by-side

acceptanceCriteria: Compare button or interface element is available on the result page
Users can select multiple resumes (at least 2) for comparison
Comparison view displays resumes in a side-by-side or tabular layout
Comparative metrics include scores, skills, experience years, and education
Visual indicators highlight differences and strengths across candidates
Users can easily switch between individual and comparison views

requirements.text: Configure automatic navigation to the result page after a user successfully uploads and analyzes a resume, passing the resume ID and analysis data through URL parameters or application state

quotes: Appears automatically after analyzing a resume
The page will automatically appear after a user uploads and analyzes a resume

acceptanceCriteria: After successful resume analysis, user is automatically redirected to the result page
Resume ID is passed to the result page for data retrieval
No manual navigation is required from the user
Transition is smooth with appropriate loading states
If analysis fails, user remains on the upload page with error feedback

requirements.text: Design the result page UI to match the existing application style with warm education-focused color palette (coral primary, teal secondary, amber accent), ensuring responsive layout, proper spacing, and visual hierarchy that highlights key information like scores and recommendations

quotes: polished UI matching your existing design

acceptanceCriteria: Result page uses the same color scheme as other pages (coral, teal, amber)
Layout is responsive and works on mobile, tablet, and desktop
Visual hierarchy emphasizes important elements (scores, gaps, recommendations)
Spacing and typography are consistent with the rest of the application
Interactive elements have appropriate hover and focus states
Loading states are smooth and informative

constraints: Use existing resumeScoring.ts service for score calculations without modification
Use existing gapAnalysis.ts service for skill matching without modification
Use existing recommendationEngine.ts service for generating recommendations without modification
Use existing pdfGenerator.ts service for PDF report generation without modification
Maintain single-actor backend architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui/*
nonGoals: Changing the existing analysis algorithms or scoring logic
Redesigning existing pages or components outside the result page
Adding new authentication mechanisms beyond Internet Identity
